channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Helen Keller — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-15
item.description: “What I am looking for is not out there, it is in me.” — Helen Keller

item.title: Charles Sanders Peirce — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-14
item.description: “Do not block the way of inquiry.” — Charles Sanders Peirce

item.title: Sophocles — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-13
item.description: “The state which belongs to one man is no state at all.” — Sophocles

item.title: Nelson Mandela — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-12
item.description: “Our march to freedom is irreversible. We must not allow fear to stand in our way.” — Nelson Mandela

item.title: Swami Vivekananda — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-11
item.description: “I am proud to belong to a religion which has taught the world both tolerance and universal acceptance.” — Swami Vivekananda

item.title: Anais Nin — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-10
item.description: “I, with a deeper instinct, choose a man who compels my strength, who makes enormous demands on me, who does not doubt my courage or my toughness, who does not believe me naïve or innocent, who has the courage to treat me like a woman.” — Anais Nin

item.title: Jawaharlal Nehru — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-09
item.description: “Let us be a little humble; let us think that the truth may not perhaps be entirely with us.” — Jawaharlal Nehru

item.title: Rumi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-08
item.description: “Where there is ruin, there is hope for a treasure.” — Rumi
